events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Shooting
events.blurb: On this day, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by in Las Vegas, an incident that tragically led to his death days later in September 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: A moment to reflect on the enduring legacy and impact of one of music's most influential and complex artists.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: On this day, the world lost a guitar legend, Jimi Hendrix, who died in London in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent who redefined the electric guitar and left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we mark an anniversary related to The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road', which was originally released in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: The album cover is as famous as the music. What's your favourite track from this legendary Beatles record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman, guitarist, and primary songwriter of The Pretenders, born in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Celebration
angles.copy: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde at 75! From Akron to rock icon, her influence with The Pretenders is undeniable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, known for his work with Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Raise a glass to the one and only Liam Gallagher, still bringing the rock and roll swagger.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we mark an anniversary related to John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine', which was originally released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message that resonates globally. What does John Lennon's 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we mark an anniversary related to Apple's introduction of the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourites
angles.copy: Licence to thrill! Happy James Bond Day – who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, a visionary artist and peace activist born in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: His music and message continue to inspire. We're celebrating the life and legacy of John Lennon today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, born in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: From 'Fawlty Towers' to 'Monty Python', John Cleese has given us decades of laughter. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we mark an anniversary related to The Beatles' revolutionary self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', which was originally released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: A blank canvas that delivered a masterpiece. What's your go-to track from The Beatles' 'White Album'?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world mourned the loss of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away at 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: His voice, his stage presence, his legacy. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul,' marking a pivotal shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: The album that started a revolution. We're celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' today! What's your favourite track?
